Research Fellow in Statistics  
Department of Economics, Management and Statistics  
Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca

My research interests are in Bayesian statistics, Bayesian
nonparametrics, statistical network analysis, and computational
statistics.

My research focuses on the development of Bayesian methods for the
analysis of complex network data, with particular emphasis on
nonparametric models and scalable computational methods.
